objective: Lower the elementary unbounded-girth seed to every fixed d>4, including a deterministic d0=5 family, and freeze the precise trusted-verification handoff without creating receipts.

atomic_claims.text: The C16 bipartite degree-39-or-40 expanding seed has no cut vertex, by a component size of at least 77 versus boundary at most 40.
Finite greedy same-part augmentation at fixed degree cap k and current distance at least g-1 gives more than kn/4 artificial edges while preserving girth.
Subdividing only the artificial edges retains the original no-MC induced core and prevents every nontrivial matching cut; the result is simple, bipartite and 2-connected.
For every d>4 and g>=3, k=ceil(144/(d-4)) yields a no-MC graph with girth>=g, average in (4,d), and maximum degree<=40+k.
Fix d0=5: for every g>=3 the deterministic finite family has average<184/37<5, girth>=g and no MC, with maximum degree<=184.
The d0=5 family has 3-core exactly the old degree-39-or-40 seed, with maximum average degree and degeneracy at least 39; naive core deletion does not preserve global density.
